title: Dieter Rams and Jony Ive
welcome_lead: Ten principles, two generations, one philosophy.
meta_desc: A-Level D&T: Dieter Rams' 10 principles and Jony Ive at Apple.

concepts.def: German industrial designer (b. 1932), Braun chief designer 1961-1995.
German consumer electronics firm; Rams designed for them 1955-1995.
Translucent Apple computer (1998), Ive's breakthrough product.

walkthroughs.body_html: Dieter Rams' 10 Principles of Good Design (codified 1970s-80s): innovative, useful, aesthetic, makes a product understandable, unobtrusive, honest, long-lasting, thorough, environmentally friendly, and 'as little design as possible'.
Jony Ive joined Apple in 1992 and became SVP Design in 1997. The iMac G3 (1998), iPod (2001), iPhone (2007) and iPad (2010) bear his stamp — much influenced by Rams' Braun designs.
Beyond the Rams-Ive lineage, contemporary practice includes Patricia Urquiola (b. 1961), whose work for Moroso, B&B Italia and Kettal blends craft, colour and pattern with industrial production.
